evidence.why: Propagates a nonzero base-loader return. Otherwise skips unless flag 0x2000, PN matrix index exists, and final texture-matrix index offset is at least 2. Computes stride from listed attributes, then treats each nonzero-high-five-bit command as a count-prefixed primitive and copies the PN index byte to the final texture-matrix index for each vertex. Stops at outer allocation end or a byte whose high five bits are zero, flushes n_display<<5 bytes and returns zero. No inner vertex/header bounds checks or general GX command validation exist.
